lines.say: Your city has one tree left. Ten minutes under it costs twenty dollars.
The queue is six hours long. People bring their grandparents. Some cry.
Your turn. You sit. It smells like rain. Best ten minutes of your year.
A kid next to you peels back the bark. There is a label.
Made in the tower. Plastic. The smell comes from a speaker.
Would you still pay to sit under it? Write it in the comments.
